Real Eggs, Real Evidence!

Back to quest database

The current large-egg route involving Gigi, a police escape and the present end of the implemented quest line.

Recorded build reference · 0.8.10.842 · configuration record, not individually play-tested

Work through the objectives

  1. Collect two large chicken eggs from your coop.
  2. Meet Gigi and finish the first quest conversation.
  3. Lose the police pursuit.
  4. Return Gigi to her home area after escaping.
  5. Speak to Gigi again to finish the final conversation check.

Checks that can cause a stop

  • The overview says 12 eggs, but both the objective and inventory check require 2 large chicken eggs. Follow the specific objective.
  • Returning home is not the last step: the final conversation and escape checks must both pass.
Failure conditions, recovery & continuation
Failure trigger
Player death, Player imprisonment, Quest actor death
After failure
Starts a configured follow-up call; not a named quest
After success
No automatic success action recorded

These route relations come from retained build fields; each branch is not runtime-tested.

Recorded reward actions
  • After handing over 2 Chicken Egg - Large： 20,000 C

These actions come from retained dialogue or quest configuration; they are not individually runtime-tested and do not guarantee delivery.

People and map links

Route position

Sources and boundary

  • An official moderator reply identifies the two-egg hand-in as the end of the main questline for now; this does not catalogue optional or unrelated quests. Official

    Source: Steam thread: official reply on the current main quest endpoint · Build: not specified

  • The retained current route requires two Large Eggs; daily care and enclosed outdoor roaming affect the chance, but the result remains random. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Real Eggs, Real Evidence · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • After handoff, Gigi follows the player during a police escape and must be returned to her home area to complete the documented route. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Real Eggs, Real Evidence · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Multiple players report no implemented follow-up after the return; waiting additional seasons is not a verified solution. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: current quest line after Real Eggs · Build: 0.8.10.x

These steps come from the recorded game build and public sources; missing rewards, prerequisites and unlock timing are not filled in.
